verdict.rationale: React's official docs embed an editable in-browser sandbox ("You don't need to install anything to play with React. Try editing this sandbox!"), and react.dev/learn offers a structured learning path, so developers can learn hands-on with no local setup. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the step-by-step tutorial lessons are themselves interactive throughout (only one sandbox mention), independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-browser learning experience.
